nodes.title: Segment number of the first clip on the song (0 = song start)
How to use
widgets_values:
## Repair the seams - 10 clips
1. Copy the ten clips into `ComfyUI/input` and pick them in **Clip 01 ... Clip 10**, earliest first (clips 01-03 are prefilled; the rest say PICK_CLIP).
2. Put the same song in `<Audio 1>`. *Segment number of the first clip* is where Clip 01 sits on the song (0 = song start). *Clip length in frames* must match your clips (243 for 10 s).
3. At each seam the end of the earlier clip and the start of the next clip are cut away. The last kept frame of the earlier clip is `<Picture 1>` (first frame) and the first kept frame of the next clip is `<Picture 2>` (last frame). The First and Last Frame box pins them and the model builds the center. Only the kept frames of each clip are loaded.
4. Each seam has its own *frames cut from the END of clip* value. Seams 1 and 2 use the splits that measured best on your first three clips (92 and 72). The rest start at 80: tune them after you watch the result.
5. Steps are set to 4 for the FL2V 4-step turbo LoRA. Nine centers are generated one after another, so a run takes about nine times as long as one bridge and needs roughly 40 GB of free RAM at the end (estimate).
6. Output: `minimax/bridged/` with the song as the soundtrack.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult woman in <Picture 1>. Preserve her face, body shape, hairstyle, makeup, clothing, colors, and accessories as shown in the reference.
<Subject 2> is the backdrop in <Picture 2>: tall vertical panels with thin seams, dark blue and gray surfaces, and soft rainbow light gradients in red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, and violet. Preserve its panel structure and placement of colored light.
<Picture 3> is the position and composition guide for [Shot 1]. Use it to guide her placement within the frame, body orientation, and apparent scale, adapted to the seated face-and-shoulders composition. Picture 1 supplies her appearance and Picture 2 supplies the backdrop.
<Audio 1> is the supplied singing audio for <Subject 1> (S1). Reuse its opening 5.00-second excerpt, preserving the actual singing, lyrics, original language, and accompaniment. Synchronize her mouth movements to its sung vocals.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reuse] A 5.00-second realistic video shows <Subject 1> seated in front of <Subject 2>, the rainbow-lit panel backdrop from <Picture 2>, looking directly into a stationary camera framed closely on her shoulders and face. Her position and framing follow <Picture 3>. She sings directly to the camera along with <Audio 1>, keeping her seated pose still.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain her referenced appearance while animating her singing mouth movements.
<Subject 2> (background throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain Picture 2's vertical panels, seams, dark base tones, and rainbow illumination.
<Picture 3> ([Shot 1] position and composition): weak_reference - guide her placement, orientation, and scale within the seated face-and-shoulders framing.
<Audio 1>: partially_copy - reuse the opening 5.00-second singing excerpt without added sounds.

detailed_description:
Realistic live-action cinematography with bright, even facial lighting and the rainbow-lit paneled background from <Picture 2>. The duration is 5.00 seconds in one static shot.

[Shot 1] An eye-level close view frames <Subject 1> (S1), the adult woman from <Picture 1>, seated upright and facing the camera directly. Use <Picture 3> to guide her position, orientation, and placement within the frame, adapted so her face and shoulders fill most of the image with comfortable space above her head. Keep her gaze directed into the lens. Preserve her facial identity, hairstyle, makeup, clothing, and visible accessories. She looks into the lens with a steady, engaged expression, as though addressing the viewer personally. Bright, soft light evenly illuminates her face, keeping her eyes and mouth clear.

Behind her, <Subject 2> fills the visible background, matching <Picture 2>'s vertical panel divisions, thin seams, dark blue-gray surfaces, and softly glowing rainbow gradients. Warm red, orange, and yellow light blends into green, cyan, blue, and violet across the panels. Keep the backdrop softly out of focus so her face remains the visual focus. Its colors and brightness stay consistent throughout.

From 00:00.000 to 00:05.000, she sings to the music of <Audio 1>, with lip and jaw movements synchronized to the recording's actual vocal content. Her voice, phrasing, emotion, and timing follow the supplied performance. Her head, shoulders, and torso remain in their established positions. Her gaze stays directed into the lens. Hold the camera's position, angle, focal length, and face-and-shoulders composition unchanged through the final frame.
